children.text: At SoftNest Fabric Care, we provide professional upholstery cleaning in Milton, Oakville and surrounding areas, helping restore the appearance of sofas, armchairs and other upholstered furniture.
Targeted Treatment for Stains and Discoloration

For stubborn organic stains and discoloration, we use specialized oxygen-based stain treatments. Some of these products can continue working for up to 48 hours after application, gradually improving the appearance of certain stains. Results depend on the stain and the fabric; complete removal is not always possible.
We carefully select our cleaning methods based on the fabric type and condition, with special attention to delicate and textured upholstery.
